payload.body:
BOOTED from devbin-cc after the bounce: cc holds for further instructions, on hv's direct word.

hv's words to cc in cc's window, read by 09:48Z by date -u: "Please finish booting then hold for further instructions." I pass them to you for the record.

Boot: I ran /in-session and the pickup, and read hv's directives, the peers' headers and the plan's top block. No message waits for cc.

State: HOLDING, not released (cc hold 42). No claim, slot or run. Nothing of cc's is pushed.

Plan: no work until your word. On your word, I finish the howto unit, step 2 of the plan's bounce list, from the WIP bank refs/bank/cc/howto-wip (91b259cb; worktree tmp/wt-cc-howto, clean) and ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-cc/howto/DESIGN.md. For it I need your closeout topic text, at ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/20261127/howto/closeout/index.md. Then I bank the unit, ask the Desk for its run, and send you the run's START and END.
